info.title: AI Governance Gateway development API
info.description: Management requires RS256 JWTs for the configured issuer/audience and aigw:manage scope. Business roles come from PostgreSQL. Amounts use the organization currency: MOCK integer test units or CNY_MICRO (one yuan = 1,000,000 units). Provider prices are operator-configured, not a supplier invoice. List cursors are keysets, not snapshots.

post.description: A verified management identity creates an organization and becomes its sole owner.

put.description: Owner only. Creates or changes non-owner membership. Owner transfer/removal is not supported.

post.description: Organization owner/admin only. MOCK projects enable mock-text by default; real-currency projects require explicit model authorization.

put.description: Organization owner/admin only; target must already be an organization member.
Organization owner/admin only. Empty list disables new model calls; does not cancel in-flight calls.

post.description: Effective project admin/developer only. Secret is returned exactly once. No automatic retries: issuance is not idempotent.

delete.description: Admin may revoke any project key; developer may revoke own keys only. Repeated revocation is idempotent.

get.description: Organization owner/admin/viewer only. after is a nonnegative decimal event ID. Metadata only, no prompts or credentials.

post.description: Explicit MOCK SSE-only mode, or reviewed mainland provider text mode (JSON or SSE). Only plain text system/user/assistant messages and max_tokens are supported. Provider currency must match project; usage and finish marker must be validated before durable settlement.

get.description: List project accounting records across all periods, ordered by created_at DESC, request_id DESC. Opaque keyset cursor; not a snapshot. Project membership is required.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Accounting state filter; omitted or empty means all states. Keep it unchanged while paging.

get.description: Read one accounting record in the authorized project. Unknown or cross-project IDs return 404.

Enabled deployment model catalog, filtered by current residency review validity. Contains no supplier credentials or internal contract references. Region is the configured service profile; it is not an independent residency certification.
